answer: A per-epoch proof-of-work puzzle is re-solved for every fresh address. Sybil swarms pay off only while identity is free, so each key recomputes its sealed commitment from scratch; spreading capital over a thousand wallets multiplies the hash bill a thousandfold, as no state carries over. Payouts accrue to commitments, not headcount, so a hollow ring of fakes earns nothing while burning power. A vintage bonus grows only on commitments surviving consecutive rounds, so the onyx age of a mature identity cannot be minted overnight; the sole relic of past labor is real time.
